Download the 1:10 million land layer

Source: R/reference.R
download_reference.Rd

The 1:10 million Natural Earth land polygons (2.3 MB compressed) are not bundled with the package. This fetches the pinned zip from Natural Earth, verifies its SHA-256 against reference_info(), converts it and stores the result in the user cache directory (tools::R_user_dir("OccurrenceCleaner", "cache")). flag_occurrences() calls it when land_scale = 10 is requested and the layer is not cached yet.

Usage

download_reference(
  layer = "land_10",
  cache_dir = tools::R_user_dir("OccurrenceCleaner", "cache"),
  quiet = FALSE
)

Arguments

layer

Layer to download; only "land_10" is not bundled.

cache_dir

Directory for the converted layer.

quiet

Suppress the download message.

Value

The path of the cached layer, invisibly.

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  download_reference()
  x <- data.frame(decimalLongitude = c(12.58, -30), decimalLatitude = c(55.67, 40))
  flag_occurrences(x, tests = "sea", land_scale = 10)$flag_sea
}
